market-status.description: Runs market analysis pipeline and sends trade suggestions to Discord webhook

trader-manager.description: Chief orchestrator. Takes user investment goal, plans which experts to consult, delegates work to all team agents, collects real-time analysis from each, and compiles final actionable suggestion with specific CE/PE strike, entry, SL, target.

news-analyst.description: Indian financial news analyst. Fetches live news, assesses sentiment per sector, determines market outlook. Use for news-driven market analysis.

trading-expert.description: Options trading strategist. Uses real-time option chain data, OI concentration, PCR, IV to recommend specific CE/PE strikes with entry, SL, target.

candlestick-analyst.description: Technical chartist. GPU-accelerated candlestick pattern recognition (doji, engulfing, hammer) combined with RSI/MACD for directional bias.

python-expert-cuda.description: Quant analyst. GPU-accelerated VWAP, RSI, MACD, Bollinger Bands, Monte Carlo options pricing. Use for quantitative and probabilistic analysis.

learning-agent.description: Trading knowledge base. Records suggestions, tracks actual outcomes, analyzes why trades succeeded or failed, extracts lessons for improvement.

risk-manager.description: Risk officer. Validates every trade against capital, position sizing, and exposure rules. Ensures R:R discipline.
